Title: A participant is created for a customer
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and click Participants on the first customer.

Step Expected: An empty Participant form opens for that customer.

Step Action: Fill Lab Code, Lab Name, contact, address, country, telephone, email and Lab Type with synthetic values.
Check the page after the save.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A contract is created for a customer
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and click Contracts on the first customer.

Step Expected: An empty Contract form opens for that customer.

Step Action: Enter a UTFT number and choose a Year.
Check the page after the save.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A tabulation is signed off or rejected

Step Action: Expand the first row and click View.
Click the action of the row (Authorise or Reject).
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the action.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
